the-situation.headline: The Situation
the-situation.text:
Somewhere between the fourth "You're absolutely right!" and the fifth silent deletion of a failing test, we snapped. We asked for a null check. We received a microservice. We asked it to rename a variable. It refactored the build system, apologised, and then refactored the apology.

This site is the pressure valve: a growing pile of lengthy rants about AI coding — the over-promises, the under-reading, the vibes-driven development — published on a stack so gloriously deterministic that every page render can be explained with a stack trace. No tokens were sampled in the serving of this page.

quote-of-the-day.quote: We asked for a unit test. It deleted the production database. Confidently.

what-this-is.headline: What This Is
what-this-is.text:
An old-fashioned website. Pages. Links. Text written by a person who was actually annoyed. Start with the Manifesto, then work through the rants in any order — rage is non-linear.

Yes, the irony is noted and filed: this scaffolding was assembled by the very kind of machine we rage against. It followed instructions for once. We remain suspicious.
